subject: Business Models
title: Cryptocurrency Commerce
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cryptocurrency Commerce usable.

hook.text: In 2009, Bitcoin proposed a radical idea: money without banks, governments, or intermediaries.

buildup.text: Blockchain technology records every transaction on a public ledger no one controls.

discovery.text: The first real Bitcoin purchase: 10,000 BTC for two pizzas in 2010. Worth $700 million today.

twist.text: Most crypto isn't used for commerce. It's used for speculation. The currency rarely buys anything.

climax.text: Whether crypto succeeds as money, blockchain technology is already transforming supply chain tracking.

punchline.text: 10,000 Bitcoin for pizza. The most expensive lunch ever.

quiz.question: What was the first real-world Bitcoin purchase?

details.summary: Cryptocurrency commerce uses blockchain-based digital currencies like Bitcoin and stablecoins for commercial transactions. While early adoption focused on speculation and illicit markets, growing merchant acceptance, stablecoin payments.
details.whyItMatters: Cryptocurrency challenges the foundation of commercial payment systems that have relied on bank intermediaries for centuries. Whether it supplements or disrupts traditional payment rails will shape the future of how money moves in global commerce.
takeaways: Blockchain enables peer-to-peer transactions without traditional payment intermediaries
Stablecoins address price volatility that made Bitcoin impractical for daily commerce
Central bank digital currencies may integrate cryptocurrency technology into state money

faq.question: Why hasn't cryptocurrency become widely used for everyday commerce?
faq.answer: Price volatility makes pricing difficult. Transaction speeds are slower than card networks. Energy consumption raises environmental concerns. Regulatory uncertainty creates merchant hesitance. Consumer protection in fraud cases is limited..

faq.question: Could stablecoins become a mainstream payment method?
faq.answer: Stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies like USDT and USDC solve the volatility problem. They enable fast, low-cost international transfers..
